Ahmedabad, Gujarat
Dynamic sales professional focused on building pipeline, managing key accounts and closing high-value B2B deals. Notice period: 90 days.

Business Development Manager, Ola — Jun 2025 - Present
Managed territory targeting enterprise and SMB accounts; developed and executed outreach campaigns that increased qualified pipeline through Lead Generation channels. Coordinated account handoffs and tracked opportunities in SFDC, maintaining accurate deal stages and forecasts. Used CRM to monitor customer interactions and follow-ups, enabling a 22% improvement in conversion from demo to contract. Collaborated with product and marketing teams via Confluence to document competitive positioning and sales playbooks.

Sales Manager, Swiggy — May 2025 - May 2025
Led short-term strategic push to onboard restaurant partners for a new corporate program, focusing on B2B Sales and rapid onboarding. Drove Lead Generation through targeted outreach and partner referrals, logging prospects and outcomes in Salesforce. Streamlined intake workflows in CRM to accelerate contract execution and ensure clean handoffs to operations.

Account Executive, Ledgerly — Aug 2024 - Apr 2025
Owned a book of mid-market accounts, managing end-to-end sales cycles with emphasis on B2B Sales and Lead Generation. Tracked leads and opportunities in SFDC and maintained client records in CRM, reducing churn risk by improving follow-up cadence. Collaborated with engineering using Git to share issue reproductions and Confluence to create onboarding documentation for new clients, contributing to a 30% faster time-to-value for pilot customers.

Skills: B2B Sales, SFDC, Lead Generation, CRM, Confluence, Git

Education: B.Sc Computer Science, St. Xavier's College
